passages.text: “Come, and let us return to Yahweh; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds. After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him. Let us acknowledge Yahweh. Let us press on to know Yahweh. As surely as the sun rises, Yahweh will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”
passages.note: Hope of healing and renewal after being broken

passages.text: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
passages.note: Compassion matters more than outward ritual
